description: The MET tower will be located at 38.352747°N, 74.753546°W.
context_quote: The proposed activity is to install and maintain a Meteorological (MET) tower located in 88.6 feet (27M) water depth at position Lat: 38.352747°N Lon: 74.753546°W

description: The MET tower will be located in 27 m of water.
context_quote: The proposed activity is to install and maintain a Meteorological (MET) tower located in 88.6 feet (27M) water depth

description: The overall height of the MET tower structure will be approximately 100 m above mean sea level.
context_quote: The overall height of the MET tower structure (mast & foundation) will be approximately 328 feet (~100 m) above the mean sea level.

description: The platform deck will be approximately 279 square meters.
context_quote: The platform deck supporting the mast will be approximately 3,000 square feet (279 square meters)

description: The main caisson pile will be driven approximately 53.3 m into the seabed.
context_quote: The main Caisson will be a 1.8 m (72 inch) diameter pile that tapers to 1.5 m (60 inch) diameter above the mudline. The pile will be driven approximately 53.3 m (175 ft) into the seabed.

description: The bracing piles will be driven approximately 50.6 m into the seabed.
context_quote: The two bracing piles will be 1.5 m (60 inch) diameter each. These piles will be driven approximately 50.6 m (166 ft) into the seabed

description: The oceanographic package will be tethered to a foundation pile with an offset of approximately 3 meters.
context_quote: The package will be tethered to a foundation pile with an offset of approximately 10 feet (3 meters).

description: MET tower will be equipped with safety lighting, markings, and signal equipment per FAA and USCG PATON requirements.
context_quote: Both the mast and the platform deck will be equipped with the proper safety lighting, markings and signal equipment per Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and United States Coast Guard (USCG) Private Aids to Navigation (PATON) requirements

description: Planned operations and maintenance visits to the MET tower will occur once a month for 2 days.
context_quote: A planned operations and maintenance (O&M) visit out to the MET tower by the US Wind Baltimore based O&M contractor is proposed once a month for 2 days duration out of Ocean City MD.

description: The oceanographic package will require 2 visits by the O&M vessel once each quarter.
context_quote: The oceanographic package will require 2 visits by the O&M vessel once each quarter for a 1 year period.

description: During decommissioning, the MET tower will be transported to an onshore licensed disposal site, an offshore artificial reef site, or transferred to a scientific/educational institute.
context_quote: Decommission in accordance with BOEM regulations and transport to an on-shore licensed disposal site...transport to an offshore artificial reef site...abandoning in place and transferring ownership...to a scientific/educational institute

description: Vessels greater than 19.8 m must operate at 10 knots or less within designated Seasonal Management Areas.
context_quote: All vessels greater than 19.8 m (65 ft) in overall length must operate at speeds of 10 knots or less within these areas during seasonal time periods.

description: Vessels must maintain a separation distance of 500 meters or greater from any North Atlantic right whale.
geographic_scope: 500 meters from North Atlantic right whale
context_quote: The Lessee must ensure all vessels maintain a separation distance of 500 meters (1,640 ft) or greater from any sighted North Atlantic right whale.

description: A 7 km radius exclusion zone for marine mammals and sea turtles must be established around each pile driving site.
context_quote: A preliminary 7 km radius exclusion zone for marine mammals and sea turtles must be established around each pile driving site

description: One observer must be stationed near the sound source, responsible for monitoring out to 1000 m.
context_quote: One observer must be based at or near the sound source and responsible for monitoring the 180 dB field of ensonification out to 1000m from the sound source.

description: An additional observer must be located on a separate vessel navigating approximately 4-5 km around the pile hammer monitoring out to 7 km.
context_quote: An additional observer must be located on a separate vessel navigating approximately 4-5 km around the pile hammer monitoring 360° out to 7km from the sound source.

description: No pile-driving will occur when conditions prevent monitoring of the exclusion zone.
context_quote: No pile-driving will occur at any time when lighting or weather conditions (darkness, rain, fog, sea state, etc.) prevent monitoring of the exclusion zone.

description: Visual monitoring of the exclusion zones must be conducted by a qualified NMFS-approved observer.
context_quote: Monitoring of the zones must be conducted by a qualified NMFS approved observer.

description: Observers must not be on watch for more than 4 consecutive hours, with at least a 2-hour break after a 4-hour watch.
context_quote: In order to ensure effective monitoring, observers must not be on watch for more than 4 consecutive hours, with at least a 2-hour break after a 4-hour watch, unless otherwise accepted by the Lessor.

description: A "soft start" procedure must be implemented at the beginning of each pile installation.
context_quote: A "soft start" must be implemented at the beginning of each pile installation in order to provide additional protection to marine mammals and sea turtles near the project area by allowing them to vacate the area prior to the commencement of pile driving activities.

description: The MET tower will be marked in accordance with USCG requirements applicable to a Private Aid to Navigation.
context_quote: To minimize this potential for navigational impacts, the MET tower will be marked in accordance with USCG requirements applicable to a Private Aid to Navigation, including color, lights, etc.
